title: Kurzurlaub Reviews

startUrls.title: Kurzurlaub hotel URLs
startUrls.description: Kurzurlaub.de hotel pages, e.g. ["https://www.kurzurlaub.de/hotel/rhein_lahn_taunus/hachenburg/parkhotel-hachenburg.html"]. Each page is read once for the hotel's id, name, stars, address and price range. Use for "reviews of this Kurzurlaub hotel". A URL from another site ends the run with the reason on the run card and nothing charged. One of startUrls or hotelIds is required.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Kurzurlaub.de hotel URLs and/or Kurzurlaub's numeric hotel ids; one of the two is required. A URL and its id are the same hotel, harvested once.

hotelIds.title: Kurzurlaub hotel ids
hotelIds.description: Kurzurlaub's numeric hotel ids, e.g. ["15699"]: the hotel_id on the rows of an earlier run (the id is not part of the hotel URL). Skips the page read: use for scheduled runs over a known list. An id Kurzurlaub does not have costs nothing and is reported as a status row with status "error" and the reason. One of startUrls or hotelIds is required.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Max ratings per hotel
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: Ratings fetched per hotel, newest first, e.g. 50 (default 200). 0 = every rating the hotel has (Kurzurlaub pages them 10-20 at a time; a busy hotel has a few hundred). The main cost control: at most N x $0.004 per hotel. maxScore and minScore are applied to these newest N, so for "every complaint in the hotel's history" set 0; for "the 30 newest ratings" set 30.
maxReviewsPerHotel.sectionDescription: Cap and filters. Kurzurlaub scores run 1 to 6 and 6 is the best. Filters run before billing: you pay only for the rows delivered.

sinceDate.title: Only ratings from this date on
sinceDate.description: Empty (default) = no date limit. "2026-09-01" (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative to the day the run starts: "30 days", "6 weeks", "3 months", "yesterday". Use for "only new reviews" on a schedule: ratings come newest first, so paging stops as soon as the date is passed and older ratings are never fetched or charged. A daily run with "2 days" delivers only what was written since; nothing older is billed.

maxScore.title: Only ratings at or below this score
maxScore.description: 0 (default) = keep every rating. 1-6 = keep only ratings at or below it on Kurzurlaub's 1-6 scale (6 is best, 4 a middling stay), e.g. 4 for "negative reviews", "complaints", "what guests disliked". Applied to the newest maxReviewsPerHotel ratings fetched: set that to 0 to scan a hotel's whole history. Filtered ratings are counted in the status row and never billed.

minScore.title: Only ratings at or above this score
minScore.description: 0 (default) = keep every rating. 1-6 = keep only ratings at or above it, e.g. 5.5 for "praise", "what guests loved", quotes for marketing. Combine with maxScore for a band (minScore must not be above maxScore). Applied to the newest maxReviewsPerHotel ratings fetched; filtered ratings are never billed.

includeHotelRow.title: Include a hotel row
includeHotelRow.description: true (DEFAULT) = one free row per hotel (type "hotel") with id, name, stars, street, city, region, country, overall score and its word, review count, category averages and price range. No charge. false = rating and status rows only.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Proxy sessions (egress IPs) run in parallel, 1-16, e.g. 2 (default 2). More is faster; each session is paced separately.
sessions.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1-3, e.g. 1 (default 1). Kurzurlaub answered 10 of 10 requests at 1/s from one IP in testing.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy so runs rotate IPs; the default datacenter group is enough for Kurzurlaub (no residential proxy needed). Traffic: one page per hotel URL plus one fragment per 10-20 ratings.

description: Kurzurlaub.de hotel reviews (Hotelbewertungen). Minimal input: {"hotelIds": ["15699"]} or {"startUrls": ["https://www.kurzurlaub.de/hotel/rhein_lahn_taunus/hachenburg/parkhotel-hachenburg.html"]}; one of the two is required. maxReviewsPerHotel defaults to 200 (the newest 200) at $0.004 per rating delivered; includeHotelRow defaults to true and is free. maxScore, minScore and sinceDate filter BEFORE billing; sinceDate also stops paging early.
